name: MAPK cascade (Huang and Ferrell 1996) driven by a held log-input of its activator E1
question: Which functions of the history of the activator E1 does the doubly phosphorylated MAPK represent?

provenance.source: C.-Y. F. Huang and J. E. Ferrell, PNAS 93, 10078 (1996), Eqs. 1-35 (mass action); rate constants a = 1000 /(uM min), d = k = 150 /min from Qiao et al., PLoS Comput. Biol. 3, e184 (2007), Text S1 central values; totals as in the source

assumptions: the individual a, d, k are Qiao's central values (the source states K_m = 300 nM only); time in minutes
free enzymes from their conservation laws: E1 = E1_tot - [KKK.E1], E2, KK phosphatase and K phosphatase likewise
input u: E1_tot = E1c exp(u), E1c = 4.16e-6 uM, the derived EC50 of the total active MAPK-PP (hf96_check.py); held for intervals of 10 min (the source applies steady inputs only)
observable: the total active fraction of MAPK, ([K-PP] + [K-PP.K P'ase])/K_tot (the free form would change n_H by about 0.2)

drift.KKKs: -a*KKKs*(E2t - KKKsE2) + d*KKKsE2 + k*KKKE1 + (k + d)*KK_KKKs - a*KKKs*KK + (k + d)*KKP_KKKs - a*KKP*KKKs
drift.KKP: -a*KKP*(KKPt - KKP_KKPase - KKPP_KKPase) + d*KKP_KKPase + k*KK_KKKs + k*KKPP_KKPase + d*KKP_KKKs - a*KKP*KKKs
drift.KKPP: k*KKP_KKKs - a*KKPP*(KKPt - KKP_KKPase - KKPP_KKPase) + d*KKPP_KKPase - a*KKPP*K + (d + k)*K_KKPP + (d + k)*KP_KKPP - a*KP*KKPP
drift.KP: k*K_KKPP - a*KP*(KPt - KP_KPase - KPP_KPase) + d*KP_KPase - a*KP*KKPP + d*KP_KKPP + k*KPP_KPase
